description: Wind speed is the magnitude of wind velocity, typically measured in meters per second (m/s) or knots. Over the ocean, wind speed at 10 meters height is a standard measurement used in oceanography and meteorology. Wind speed is a fundamental parameter for calculating momentum flux, latent and sensible heat flux, and gas transfer across the air-sea interface. In the Southern Ocean, high wind speeds associated with the westerly wind belt significantly impact ocean mixing, upwelling, and the formation of Antarctic Bottom Water.
title: Wind Speed
